Fix round on docs/spec-hook-gates.tex per code review (8 findings):
a bare \Xi inside text mode that corrupted pdflatex output, \where used
outside a schema (misplaced \crcr under fuzz.sty), a stale "four
operations" count (three: MuteSkip, NotAVerifier, VerifierGateHit), a
LoudSkip cross-reference into a section it isn't defined in, a
section-number citation into spec-mission-lifecycle.tex that drifted
after that document's own re-baseline (now cited by title), a theorem
row that implied MuteSkip takes an input probcli already rejected
(re-attributed the free choice to INITIALISATION), pretooluse.go
citations that omitted the actual deny return, and a GateState
composition-fact argument that only established one direction of an
iff (added the converse plus the practical-unreachability caveat on
buildVerifierAllowlistEnv's empty-list return).

Also corrects an inaccurate claim: -model_check halts at the first
deadlock, so the state/transition count it reports for the MuteSkip
decoupled document is exploration-order-dependent, not a fixed
property of the model -- repeated runs observed 1-3 states and 4-7
transitions before halting. The document now reports the range and
states the caveat explicitly; the two-step counter-example trace,
which is reproducible on every run, is what the finding actually
rests on. The LoudSkip and main-document rows are exhaustive runs
with no violation and their counts are unaffected.

Verified: fuzz check (0 errors), pdflatex -halt-on-error (two clean
passes, no undefined references), probcli -model_check on the main
document (6 states/24 transitions, 7/7 operations covered) and on
both decoupled scratch documents (mute: deadlock, reproducible
2-step trace; loud: 4 states/8 transitions, no deadlock), make check
green.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <[redacted-email]>
EOF
)" -- docs/spec-hook-gates.tex
